verdict.rationale: LobeChat documents scheduled/automated Tasks that run agents on a time-based trigger without manual initiation (docs-24, docs-31, docs-46), which is a form of automatic action-triggering, but there is no evidence of a general event-driven rule engine (e.g., triggers on external events, webhooks, or conditional 'if X happens then Y' rules) beyond time scheduling. missing for 10: evidence of non-schedule event triggers (webhooks, state-change conditions), a rule-definition UI/API distinct from simple task scheduling, and independent confirmation of reliability.
